_README: Zones for the island, cloned from a vanilla MTAreaVolume.
A zone is what makes people exist. MTZoneState is keyed by ZoneKey and
carries Server_Residents, NumResidents and BusTransportRate; Jeju has
exactly seven volumes (Ara, Gwangjin, Gangjung, Jeju, Hallim, Seongsan,
Gapa) and Arini was inside none of them, so its bus stops held 0
passengers no matter how long anyone waited.
world  = centre of the box, in WORLD coordinates.
scale  = RelativeScale3D on the brush, which is a unit box. Vanilla
Gangjung is [1000, 1000, 500]. Ours covers the whole island,
which is 14 km square -- far larger than any vanilla zone, so
expect to shrink it around whatever actually gets populated.
UNPROVEN: a zone may not be sufficient. Residents likely need POIs to
live at -- MTResidentZoneState carries a POIs array and MTZoneState a
Server_Supermarkets one. A zone over empty ground may report zero.
